title: Non-anchor position period prediction v6
rationale: This lane predeclares a position-only period rule before scoring source-backed observations. It does not use public-anchor-derived key fragments, candidate words, routed public spans, or prior anchor match counts as discovery evidence, so it is not another public-anchor mining pass.
prediction_target: Future independently sourced non-anchor K4 position observations should be enriched in one or more predeclared residue classes from the registered period set before any candidate-word, key-material, route, or public-anchor-fragment scoring is performed.
discovery_inputs: Registered period set fixed before evaluation: 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 13
Deterministic residue-class rule emitted before observing new source-backed positions
evaluation_inputs: Future source-documented non-anchor K4 position observations
A committed held-out non-anchor position set not derived from prior public clue alignments
controls: multiple-comparison correction across registered periods and residue classes
